skills.name: malloy-phrase-detection
skills.description: How to turn a storefront question into get_context search targets, including the shop vocabulary that does not appear anywhere in the model. Replaces the built-in phrase-detection guide for this package.

skills.name: storefront-conventions
skills.description: What storefront's measures actually count, and the four places a reasonable reading of them is wrong. Read before answering any revenue, order, margin, or region question against this package.

payload.skills_note: This package ships its own guidance, listed above. Read the relevant one before relying on names or conventions from this package. If it is already loaded as a skill, use that; otherwise fetch it with get_skill(skill_name, scopes), and if that tool is not available to you, proceed and say which guidance you could not read. A guide whose name matches a built-in one replaces it here.
